# Test source

```ts
  193 |  * made by script (Element.animate, which Motion uses), and inline styles a
  194 |  * script rewrites frame after frame (a JavaScript-driven tween). Read with
  195 |  * `motionSeen`. Under reduced motion nothing may appear here: an animation of
  196 |  * 1ms or less counts as none, since it changes nothing a person can see.
  197 |  */
  198 | export async function recordMotion(context) {
  199 |   await context.addInitScript(() => {
  200 |     const seen = [];
  201 |     window.__rjMotion = seen;
  202 |     const name = (el) => {
  203 |       if (!el || !el.tagName) return "?";
  204 |       const cls = String(el.className?.baseVal ?? el.className ?? "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 4).join(".");
  205 |       return `${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}${el.id ? `#${el.id}` : ""}${cls ? `.${cls}` : ""}`;
  206 |     };
